Explore our latest active listings featuring luxury residential and commercial properties across New York. Find your next home or investment in the city’s most sought-after locations.

Active Commercial Properties

Central Park Avenue, NY

ADDRESS: 734-760 Central Park Avenue, Scarsdale, NY 10583

DESCRIPTION: Corner five building mixed-use package on Central Park Avenue in prime Scarsdale, mixed-use impact district consisting of (9) Residential Units over (8) Commercial Units and a 16+ parking lot in the rear. The property has been under the same ownership for over 30 years and offers immediate upside on residential unit turnover and potential redevelopment.

NOI/Cap: $273,970 / 6% Cap
